test_score_function_loss: test the score function loss for Monte Carlo gradient estimation with constant, linear, and quadratic functions
test_pathwise_loss: test the pathwise derivative loss for reparameterized gradient estimation with constant, linear, and quadratic functions
test_measure_valued_loss: test the measure valued loss with weighted linear, quadratic, and non-polynomial functions under coupling options
test_measure_valued_consistency_with_rep: test measure valued gradient consistency with reparameterization gradient for non-polynomial functions
test_reparam_gradient_zero_for_constant: test that reparameterization gradients are zero for constant functions under pathwise loss
